result.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in app/models/post.rb: `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` short-circuits before `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)`. The inline comment ('we can skip the rendering pipeline') shows this is intentional, so it's not clearly a defect, but it is a concrete, substantive review concern: raw, unsanitized HTML from RSS feeds (TopicEmbed.import sets cook_method: raw_html) will never pass through after_post_cook filters such as plugin-based sanitization or link rewriting, which is decision-relevant for a maintainer assessing security of feed

judged_text: Post#cook returns raw before applying Plugin::Filter :after_post_cook for raw_html posts, so plugins relying on after_post_cook (sanitization, link rewriting) silently don't run on RSS-imported posts

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/post.rb, Post#cook now immediately `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)`. TopicEmbed.import creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, so RSS/imported posts will skip all `:after_post_cook` plugin hooks (including any sanitization/link rewriting done there) and `post.cooked` will equal `post.raw` (also asserted in spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb).
